resources.string: Wear your strap overnight to build the existing personal HRV baseline. A missing recovery score is not zero.
No recovery score is stored for this day. Overnight signals and a usable personal baseline are needed for local recovery.
These comparisons use available readings from the preceding 30 calendar days. They provide context; they do not reconstruct or explain an imported recovery score.
Deviation from the stored personal baseline
Explore associations between your local journal and recovery history. Associations do not establish cause and effect.
The suggested range uses the existing recovery category from this same day. It is guidance for the local model, not a measured physiological threshold.
This day has no recovery score, so no strain target is suggested. A score from another day is not used.
No effort score is stored for this day. Heart rate is needed to estimate local cardiovascular load.

The 0–21 display converts the stored Effort of %1$s out of 100 using the existing unit mapping. Local scores use NOOP’s model; imported scores retain their source meaning. This display is not WHOOP’s proprietary calculation.
